instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ahmed Shakir Abd Al-Rida
subject: 03_Data_Mining

questions.question: How many database scans does Apriori typically need?
questions.question_ar: كم مسحة لقاعدة البيانات تحتاج Apriori عادة؟
questions.explanation: Apriori rescans the database at each level, so it needs multiple scans.
questions.explanation_ar: Apriori تعيد مسح القاعدة عند كل مستوى، فتحتاج مسحات متعددة.

questions.question: How many main scans does FP-Growth use to build the tree?
questions.question_ar: كم مسحة رئيسية تستخدم FP-Growth لبناء الشجرة؟
questions.explanation: FP-Growth usually needs two main scans to build the FP-tree.
questions.explanation_ar: FP-Growth تحتاج عادة مسحتين رئيسيتين لبناء شجرة FP.

questions.question: What is the main strategy of Apriori?
questions.explanation: Apriori generates candidates and prunes those with an infrequent subset.
questions.explanation_ar: Apriori تولّد المرشحات وتقلّم ما يحوي مجموعة فرعية غير متكررة.

questions.question: What is the main strategy of FP-Growth?
questions.explanation: FP-Growth compresses data into an FP-tree and grows patterns from it.
questions.explanation_ar: FP-Growth تضغط البيانات في شجرة FP وتنمّي الأنماط منها.

questions.question: What does the enumeration-tree root represent?
questions.explanation: The root of an enumeration tree is the empty itemset.
questions.explanation_ar: جذر شجرة التعداد هو المجموعة الفارغة.

questions.question: How does Depth-First Search explore an enumeration tree?
questions.question_ar: كيف يستكشف البحث بالعمق شجرة التعداد؟
questions.explanation: DFS goes as deep as possible along one branch before backtracking.
questions.explanation_ar: البحث بالعمق يمضي عميقاً في فرع واحد قبل الرجوع.

questions.question: When is a branch of the enumeration tree pruned?
questions.question_ar: متى يُقلَّم فرع من شجرة التعداد؟
options: when it has only one item
when it has too many items
when its support is too low
when its support is too high
options_en: when it has only one item
when it has too many items
when its support is too low
when its support is too high
questions.explanation: A branch is pruned when its itemset is infrequent, so no superset can help.
questions.explanation_ar: يُقلَّم الفرع عندما تكون مجموعته غير متكررة، فلا تفيد أي مجموعة أكبر.

questions.question: What is the main limitation of enumeration trees?
questions.explanation: Without pruning, the tree grows exponentially with the number of items.
questions.explanation_ar: دون تقليم، تنمو الشجرة أُسّياً مع عدد العناصر.
